description: This file implements the StateObserver class, which manages session server states for applications, including tracking state changes, retrieving current states, and identifying the active application within the rialto::servermanager namespace.

classes.name: StateObserver
classes.description: A class that observes and manages the state of session servers for different applications, providing methods to update and query application states.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: Updates the session server state for a given application ID.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Retrieves the current session server state for a specified application ID.

methods.name: getActiveApp
methods.description: Returns the application ID of the currently active session, if any.
